007package com.oracle.database.selectai.samples.selectai;
008
009import com.oracle.database.selectai.Conversation;
010import com.oracle.database.selectai.SelectAI;
011import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.ConversationAttributes;
012import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.DbConnectionConfig;
013import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.SelectAIException;
014import org.slf4j.Logger;
015import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
016
017/**
018 * Sample for opening an existing Select AI conversation through {@link SelectAI}.
019 *
020 * <p>This sample demonstrates how to create a {@link SelectAI} client, call
021 * {@link SelectAI#conversation(String)}, and print conversation metadata.</p>
022 *
023 * <p>Required environment variables:</p>
024 * <ul>
025 *   <li>SELECTAI_DB_USER</li>
026 *   <li>SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD</li>
027 *   <li>SELECTAI_JDBC_URL</li>
028 *   <li>SELECTAI_CONVERSATION_ID</li>
029 * </ul>
030 *
031 * <p>Example {@code SELECTAI_JDBC_URL}:</p>
032 * <pre>{@code
033 * jdbc:oracle:thin:@mydb_high?TNS_ADMIN=/path/to/wallet
034 * }</pre>
035 *
036 * <p>Before compiling or running this sample, build the SDK jar and copy runtime
037 * dependencies. Run the dependency copy command after {@code mvn clean install},
038 * because Maven {@code clean} removes the {@code target/} directory.</p>
039 * <pre>{@code
040 * mvn clean install
041 * mvn -Psamples -DincludeScope=runtime -DoutputDirectory=target/dependency dependency:copy-dependencies
042 * }</pre>
043 *
044 * <p>Compile and run this sample:</p>
045 * <pre>{@code
046 * javac --release 17 -cp "target/select-ai-1.0.0.jar:target/dependency/*" -d samples/out samples/src/main/java/com/oracle/database/selectai/samples/selectai/OpenConversationSample.java
047 * java -cp "samples/out:target/select-ai-1.0.0.jar:target/dependency/*" com.oracle.database.selectai.samples.selectai.OpenConversationSample
048 * }</pre>
049 *
050 * <p>This sample prints normal result data to standard output so it is easy to
051 * read when run from a terminal. It uses the logger only for error reporting
052 * and diagnostics.</p>
053 */
054public final class OpenConversationSample {
055    private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(OpenConversationSample.class);
056
057    private OpenConversationSample() {
058    }
059
060    public static void main(String[] args) {
061        String conversationId = requiredEnv("SELECTAI_CONVERSATION_ID");
062
063        try {
064            SelectAI selectAI = createSelectAI();
065            Conversation conversation = selectAI.conversation(conversationId);
066            ConversationAttributes attributes = conversation.getConversationAttributes();
067
068            System.out.printf("Conversation ID : %s%n", valueOrEmpty(conversation.getConversationId()));
069            System.out.printf("Attributes      : %s%n", attributes == null ? "" : attributes.toJson());
070        } catch (SelectAIException e) {
071            LOGGER.error("Failed to open Select AI conversation '{}'.", conversationId, e);
072        }
073    }
074
075    private static SelectAI createSelectAI() throws SelectAIException {
076        DbConnectionConfig dbConnectionConfig = DbConnectionConfig.builder()
077                .dbUser(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_USER"))
078                .dbPassword(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD"))
079                .jdbcUrl(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_JDBC_URL"))
080                .build();
081
082        return SelectAI.create(dbConnectionConfig);
083    }
084
085    private static String requiredEnv(String name) {
086        String value = System.getenv(name);
087        if (value == null || value.isBlank()) {
088            throw new IllegalStateException("Missing required environment variable: " + name);
089        }
090        return value;
091    }
092
093    private static String valueOrEmpty(String value) {
094        return value == null ? "" : value;
095    }
096}
